scope_checked.method: Current item IDs, frontmatter publication statuses, definitions/statements/proof contracts, and category pages were inspected. Search was performed for entropy, Shannon, mutual information, KL, Rényi, f-divergence, data processing, testing, Fano, Pinsker, and quantum relative entropy/Holevo/strong subadditivity terms. This is a subject-scoped supplier audit, not a whole-corpus audit.

information_theory_category.note: No published local classical information-theory content items currently supply the requested theory.

available_suppliers.gap: The inspected current QC/operator items do not define von Neumann entropy, quantum relative entropy, Holevo information, or prove quantum relative-entropy monotonicity/strong subadditivity. Finite-dimensional state/channel/trace-distance suppliers are useful for r6 but cannot discharge classical KL/Rényi proofs or quantum entropy claims.

near_misses_that_must_not_be_overclaimed.reason: Finite entropy/KL conventions only, not general Shannon information theory.
Uniform finite experiment only; no general joint-law MI interface.
A specific private-message conditional entropy drop, not general conditioning reduces entropy.
One exponential-loss minimizer, not general KL projection or BA convergence.
Definition assumes a nonempty projection set; does not establish existence.
Quantum trace-distance contractivity, not quantum relative entropy data processing.
Log determinant concavity alone does not establish operator monotonicity or quantum information inequalities.
